# MindWorkflow — AI Workspace for Turning Ideas Into Action

> MindWorkflow is an AI-powered workspace and workflow automation platform designed to turn brainstormed thoughts, notes, voice dictation, and documents into structured visual mind maps, prioritized Kanban workflows, and actionable execution plans.

## Product Overview
- **Name**: MindWorkflow
- **URL**: https://mindworkflow.in/
- **Category**: BusinessApplication / Workflow Automation / AI Workspace
- **Positioning**: AI Workspace for Turning Ideas Into Action
- **Primary AI Models**: Gemini 3.7 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro Reasoning
- **License/Tier**: 100% Free Forever Tier with unlimited node and map creation.

## Core Capabilities
1. **AI Workflow Automation**: Transform single prompts, voice notes, or PDF documents into multi-level hierarchical mind maps in seconds.
2. **Action Tasks Kanban**: 1-click conversion from mind map ideas into prioritized sprint backlog tasks, subtask checklists, and AI milestones (7/14/30-day horizons).
3. **Multi-Algorithm Visual Layouts**: Radial, Tree Vertical, Left-to-Right, Right-to-Left, and Fishbone diagramming with auto-balancing.
4. **Multimodal Ingestion**: Live voice transcription and OCR text/PDF document ingestion.
5. **AI Study & Memory Engine**: Generate flashcards, quizzes, and spaced-repetition study decks from any branch.
6. **Multi-Format Export**: Export to Markdown, PNG, SVG, PDF, and JSON.
7. **Cloud Persistence & Security**: Encrypted multi-tenant storage with local auto-save resilience.
